items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: by going to the movies and seeing the old news reels of Benny Goodman and Gene Krupa.

ctx.x: And I had one of the lowest grade point averages ever recorded in the school history. But by that point I was totally obsessed with music. And it was just being in that environment. And I mean playing dance music, I mean that’s what the whole thing is. It was never — I never had the mentality of being like a drum star, even though in those days my hero was Gene Krupa. Because that’s how I really started liking drums anyhow, by going to the movies and seeing the old news reels of Benny Goodman and Gene Krupa. And…
